title: Welcome to Track Your Foods
summary: The initial release brings you a comprehensive food tracking experience with social features, location-based restaurant search, and privacy controls.
features: Track restaurant visits with ratings, notes, and photos
Find nearby restaurants using Google Places API with GPS and manual location search
Rate food items with 5-star system ("Don't eat ever" to "Eat often")
Upload menu photos and use OCR scanning to extract menu items automatically
Add friends via QR codes or friend codes to share your food experiences
View friends' visits on your home feed (respecting privacy settings)
Control visit visibility - share with friends or keep private
Submit feedback and feature requests directly in the app
Invite-only system - first user can generate invite codes for friends
Chronological home feed grouped by month and day
Search restaurants by name, location, or cuisine type
Edit or delete your visits anytime
Customize profile with name and manage account settings
